Roper Technologies go-to-market change distribution channel 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述銷售通路主要為直銷辦公室、製造商代表、經銷商與配銷商；10-K 該節未載明通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: Distribution and sales occur primarily through direct sales offices, manufacturers’ representatives, resellers, and distributors.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 兩次搜尋未見 2026 年通路或 go-to-market 結構性轉變的報導；商業模式向垂直軟體／訂閱的轉移為長期趨勢，僅有二手來源，未取得可逐字原文。

clues.claim: Piper Sandler 會議摘要：Roper 設有 25–30 人 AI accelerator 團隊協助各事業開發 agentic 產品；CentralReach 以 freemium 模式帶動快速採用。
clues.source: Quartr, Piper Sandler 5th Annual Growth Frontiers Conference summary
